attribution_scope: Actual new-risk model performance on real AV; not a pure risk-only ablation because the upstream model also uses bounded regenerative state projection

cohort.paired_source: Audio and original video decoded from the same hash-verified FLV
cohort.selection: Thirty complete actors sorted by SHA256(hcsn-real-av-cohort-v1: + actor_id)

comparison_scope: Equal 128-update fit budgets and data exposure with identical validation selection; selected weights may come from32/64/128 updates; full128-update CPU is reported; no fixed-CPU equivalence claim
cost: All failures retained; raw process wall, CPU, peakRSS; GPU and joules null; dataset preparation measured separately
derangement_scope: Within-actor derangement may change emotion and sentence; it measures general sensitivity to destroying the pair, not a specific proof of temporal synchronization

features.audio: 16kHz mono; 25ms Hann, 10ms hop, FFT512; 64 triangular mel bands; log floor1e-8
features.normalization: Per-modality training-actor moments only; std floor1e-5
features.sampling: Both modalities interpolated to common-interval bin centers; concatenate 64 values and 64 backward differences
features.scope: Time-normalized offline low-level encoder; no pretrained backbone, identity objective, natural-language queries or streaming claim
features.time_input: dt=1 for all32 observations in allclips and allmodalities; cumulative time is identical; original clip duration is not supplied as an input
features.video: Original timestamped frames; area resize16x16 grayscale; orthonormal DCT upper8x8

forbidden_changes: No test-based retuning, omitted failed models, test-set redefinition or replacement of old protocol evidence
inference_scope: Three training seeds are descriptive; actor is the generalization unit; no registered significance or superiority gate
minibatches: Same seeded without-replacement permutation prefix for each model/seed; no repeated clip within one batch
model_change: Frozen risk_margin_j_risk uses margin, continuation J and actual first-event risk P; inherits the audited stable regenerative projection and unnormalized killed survival operator
parent_matrix_status_at_registration: Started; execution status and CPU costs inspected, no intermediate AV quality score used to set this supplement
preflight: Same eight train-only clips from the original preflight, now all dt=1; seed9401; two optimizer updates per arm; finite connected gradients and nonzero group changes; disposable checkpoints
primary_metrics: fused acted-emotion recognition accuracy and CE
same-recording audiovisual retrieval recall1 in both directions
probability_gate: Every HCSN forward, training and evaluation: finite, nonnegative, max unit-mass error <=1e-4 on all 32 observations; original v2 kernel retained
registration_scope: Post-baseline supplement registered after the prior21-job matrix started; no change to that study and no tuning based on intermediate AV quality scores
risk_bounds: Every forward: first-event probability finite and in[-1e-9,1+2e-6], matching the upstream preflight roundoff contract
selection: Minimum validation fused CE; earlier update breaks ties; no test-based model evaluation before selection lock; fixed preprocessing and integrity checks are outcome-free
timing_confound: Original same-recording duration metadata is common to modalities and can solve retrieval without content; direct duration input removed before any formal fit or heldout model evaluation
